entries.name: AppNavigator
entries.rationale: Composes application state, shared navigation effects, top bar, and modal layers; session screens and all main tabs are already delegated to focused route components.
entries.followUp: Extract shared navigation effects into a controller when deep-link or session-result behavior changes; keep route props in their route modules.

entries.name: createQuestionCatalogue
entries.rationale: Coordinates remote, cache, and bundled catalogue precedence with integrity checks, enrichment, timeout handling, and instance-local catalogue state.
entries.followUp: Split source loading from catalogue assembly when a new source or integrity rule is introduced; preserve precedence with catalogue behavior tests.

entries.name: createProgressController
entries.rationale: Owns one application instance's progress snapshot and listener lifecycle while composing hydration, answer transitions, local/remote persistence, and action factories.
entries.followUp: Extract persistence coordination when sync ordering or storage policy changes; keep snapshot and subscription lifecycle owned by this controller.

entries.name: validateProduction
entries.rationale: Applies related production-response validations and aggregates editorial findings in one pure domain rule.
entries.followUp: Separate a validation family when its publication policy changes independently; retain finding parity tests.

entries.name: useHomeViewModel
entries.rationale: Builds the home screen's presentation model from progress, curriculum, quests, and recommendations; extracted presentation components consume this one coherent snapshot.
entries.followUp: Move a calculation into a pure model when it gains an independent rule set or a non-React consumer.

entries.name: <callback>
entries.rationale: The callback selects and ranks a recommended learning item within the home view-model calculation.
entries.followUp: Give the ranking policy a named pure function and focused tests when recommendation rules next change.

entries.name: AccountManagementCard
entries.rationale: Composes account actions and their visible pending/error states; deletion and account-action hooks have already been extracted from this view.
entries.followUp: Extract a subview when another independent account action or state group is added; retain accessibility and partial-deletion behavior tests.

entries.name: AuthScreen
entries.rationale: Coordinates authentication mode, submission state, validation, and the auth screen's presentation components.
entries.followUp: Move form state and validation into a dedicated view-model when authentication modes or validation rules change.

entries.name: AuthScreenBody
entries.rationale: Renders the authentication form's related field, mode, verification, and error states as one screen body.
entries.followUp: Extract a focused field group when its layout or accessibility behavior changes independently.

entries.name: PracticeHubScreen
entries.rationale: Composes practice entry points, curriculum progress, checkpoint availability, and session choices; exam option presentation is already a separate component.
entries.followUp: Extract curriculum progress or session selection when that flow receives an independent interaction or policy change.

entries.name: useAppSession
entries.rationale: Maintains the app's session state machine, persistence restoration, and transition callbacks in one React adapter.
entries.followUp: Move transition rules into a pure application session model when new screen states or restoration rules are added.
